tools.name: smsblast_get_account
tools.description: Read the SMSBlast account: organization id and name, prepaid balance, default sender number and whether that sender is verified. Use it to check the API key and the balance before sending. Free. GET /api/v2/me.

tools.description: WRITE, SENDS REAL MESSAGES AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS (or an MMS when mediaUrl is set) from a verified sender number to one recipient or up to 100 recipients in one call. tools.name: smsblast_opt_out_contact
tools.description: WRITE: stop all further messages to one contact, matched by phone number in the account. Use it when a recipient asks to stop. Repeating the call is safe; the reply says whether the contact was already opted out. Returns 404 when no contact in the account has that number. POST /api/v2/contacts/opt-o

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smsblast_send_sms" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: WRITE, SENDS REAL MESSAGES AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS (or an MMS when mediaUrl is set) from a verified sender number to one recipient or up to 100 reci…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smsblast_send_sms · Private data: smsblast_get_account, smsblast_send_sms, smsblast_opt_out_contact · Public sink: smsblast_send_sms, smsblast_opt_out_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smsblast_send_sms · Private data: smsblast_get_account, smsblast_send_sms, smsblast_opt_out_contact · Public sink: smsblast_send_sms, smsblast_opt_out_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
